quality_gate.note: Batch 074 is reconciled at 771 answer-eligible Evidence Families, 768 content-verified families and 2,580 distinct propositions. This is two families and six propositions below the nine-family/27-proposition expectation; item-level AID dedup/eligibility audit is pending. primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result

verification_surge.effort_target: 75-85% promotion/verification until backlog is materially reduced; 15-25% breadth expansion
verification_surge.homogeneous_batch_target: 20-50 records when direct authorized item witnesses are stable and rights permit
blocking_reasons: metadata ambiguity or unresolved identity/dedup conflict

development_recovery.primary_bottleneck: Bibliographic identities are not inspected content; maintenance had no acquisition step and no content inspection.
development_recovery.required_agent_action: Continue original-language Hebrew/Yiddish witnesses and additional document types; treat English translations as non-independent witnesses in their underlying Evidence Families; preserve item-level locators and context limits.
development_recovery.last_run_note: Batch 074 manually inspected nine new item-level Hebrew/Yiddish publisher bodies and re-inspected existing AID 5357369. Added 26 new non-verbatim propositions across nine new Evidence Families and one additional proposition to AID 5357369 in its existing family. Three items are secretary-signed in the Rebbe's name; AID 4731080 is marked as a secretariat copy; AID 5357253 is marked as transcribed from a photograph, which was not inspected. Four candidates (5413764, 5054497, 4754352, 4666220) redirected to rewritten summary shells and were excluded; nine accessible alternatives were inspected in the same run. No crawler retry, access-control bypass, full-text copying, audience change or permission change. Expected readiness: 764→773 unique families, 761→770 content-verified families, 2559→2586 propositions, pending deterministic reconciliation. Actual reconciliation after the batch: 771 answer-eligible families, 768 content-verified families and 2,580 propositions (+7, +7, +21), which is two families/six propositions below the expected delta. An item-level audit is being run before treating the remaining two identities as eligible.
development_recovery.last_batch_blocked_reason: AIDs 5413764, 5054497, 4754352 and 4666220 redirected to rewritten Torah Texts summary shells without item-level bodies. No propositions were inferred from titles or metadata; nine other accessible publisher bodies were inspected instead.
next_work: Inspect the item-level reconciliation audit to identify which of the nine new AIDs were already represented or did not pass answer eligibility.
Run the commit-bound test_content_readiness.mjs and answer-integrity gates against the reconciled index; fix only evidence-supported failures.
